description: $0.02 USDC on Solana per op - the payment buys one signed listing-vs-live consistency grade: the service fetches the listing's own URL live and grades url, method, resource, price, asset and network field by field (CONSISTENT / INCONSISTENT / PARTIALLY-OBSERVABLE / UNREACHABLE).

listing.description: The listing under check, in the op's published form (check: url, method, network, asset, price_micro; example: example_input + input_schema; promise: max_timeout_seconds + declared_delivery_seconds).
